premises.name: HypV
premises.text: verifier soundness relative to the public input: a proof accepted for pih is accepted for every header with the same pih

notes: FACT (Thm 6.8): the proof's public input m must determine the consumed facts c = (parent lbn, parent hash, index); ker(m) ⊄ ker(c), so a proof for one batch position verifies at another with equal roots and data.
witness_or_proof: h, h2 differing only in parentBatchHash (bytes 217..249): identical public input, distinct parents.
